item.title: $8.6m brings marae into heart of New Plymouth
item.description: A new central marae will place culture, resilience and community at the heart of the city.

item.title: Investment strengthens resilience for two Tākitimu marae
item.description: Two Hawke’s Bay marae damaged in a cyclone will be rebuilt in safer locations with $27.6 million in Government funding.

item.title: $10m investment in new Ringatū Marae complex
item.description: The Government is investing just over $10 million to upgrade a national marae complex in the Bay of Plenty.

item.title: Energy resilience for Far North marae
item.description: A grant will fund solar panels and batteries for five marae.

item.title: Unlocking papakāinga across New Zealand
item.description: New national environmental standards make it easier for Māori landowners to build homes.
